newsitem.title: CHINA: CASIL TELECOM DEBUTS AT HK$1.80/SHARE.
newsitem.headline: CASIL TELECOM DEBUTS AT HK$1.80/SHARE.

text.p: Shares of CASIL Telecommunications Holdings Ltd, a unit of China Aerospace International Holdings Ltd, made their trading debut at HK$1.80 each, compared with an issue price of HK$1.18 each.
CASIL Telecom, a telecommunications equipment manufacturer, issued 150 million shares at HK$1.18 each in an initial public offering (IPO) of shares in Hong Kong.

Among the issue, 30 million shares were offered to China Aerospace's existing shareholders, 7.5 million were offered to CASIL Telecom's employees, and a total of 83.94 million shares were offered to an affiliate of CIS Technology and Taiwan-based construction and property concern Dimerco group.
The remainder was offered to the public in Hong Kong and was 71 times subscribed.
CASIL Telecom said it would use the net proceeds to develop its telecommunications products.
